name: Citizenship by Descent (Jus Sanguinis)

qualifying_event.description: A child automatically acquires Finnish citizenship if the mother is a Finnish citizen at birth, regardless of marital status or the child's place of birth. If the father is a Finnish citizen, automatic acquisition depends on the parents' marital status and the child's birthplace -- see requirement groups.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parent's proof of Finnish citizenship; for unmarried fathers, confirmation of paternity.

requirements.blocker_text: Automatic Finnish citizenship if the mother is a Finnish citizen at the time of birth, regardless of the parents' marital status or the child's place of birth.

requirement_groups.name: Child of a Finnish father, parents married

requirements.blocker_text: Automatic Finnish citizenship if the father is a Finnish citizen at birth AND the parents are married to each other at the time of birth.

requirement_groups.name: Child of a Finnish father, unmarried parents, born in Finland

requirements.blocker_text: Automatic Finnish citizenship once paternity is officially confirmed, if the child is born in Finland to an unmarried Finnish-citizen father.

sources.title: Maahanmuuttovirasto -- Finnish Citizenship for a Child: automatic acquisition rules by parent's citizenship, sex, marital status, and birthplace

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Finland). IMPORTANT AND STILL-CURRENT ASYMMETRY, explicitly flagged: Finnish descent citizenship is NOT uniformly gender-neutral even today -- a Finnish MOTHER transmits citizenship automatically and unconditionally, while a Finnish FATHER transmits it automatically only if married to the mother at birth, or (if unmarried) only once paternity is officially confirmed AND the child is born in Finland. A fourth case -- unmarried Finnish father, child born ABROAD -- is NOT automatic at all: the child must acquire citizenship 'by declaration,' a distinct legal process (available for those born after 1 June 2003; children born abroad out of wedlock to a Finnish father before that date required a full citizenship APPLICATION instead). This declaration path is disclosed here rather than modeled as a fourth 'automatic' requirement group, since it is structurally a different (assessed, not automatic) mechanism -- consistent with this dataset's practice of disclosing rather than force-fitting edge cases that don't match the route's primary selection_method.
